description: Energie et patrimoine communal -5- Bâtiments is published by ADEME. It describes results from a five-yearly survey of French local-authority building energy use, expenditure and associated emissions, with 2012–2017 comparisons. Coverage is national within FR. Spatial resolution is not established here. Temporal coverage: 2012 and 2017. Access is through the public metadata page and its provider links. The metadata lists url, xlsx, csv; these files were not downloaded. Licence: Licence Ouverte 2.0. The public page or repository can be read without payment; this does not establish free access to every linked artefact. This is a national survey product, not one local authority’s inventory; Q1 does not apply. This review identifies capacity planning, climate adaptation as potential simulation uses, subject to the stated limits. Related catalogue records are model-energyplus. These are contextual links; no unverified interoperability or actual use is claimed.
